description: FREE lite security headers + TLS audit of a website URL. Runs the same 11 checks as audit_secheaders but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, exposure-risk level, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — detail is capped (no per-check evidence, no site block, no detailed fixes). Use this to triage whether a site needs the full audit_secheaders report, or call audit_secheaders directly for the complete evidence-backed scan.

url.description: Website URL to audit (https preferred), e.g. https://example.com

name: audit_secheaders_lite
